note: Bootstrap 4 Modal registers a Drupal AJAX dialog type 'bootstrap4_modal' (response format drupal_bootstrap4_modal via Bootstrap4ModalRenderer). Declarative use via .use-ajax links with data-dialog-type=bootstrap4_modal and data-dialog-options; programmatic use via OpenBootstrap4ModalDialogCommand / OpenBootstrap4ModalDialogByUrlCommand / CloseBootstrap4ModalDialogCommand (JS: openBootstrap4Dialog / openBootstrap4DialogByUrl / closeBootstrap4Dialog). Modal target #drupal-bootstrap4-modal. It has no config form/permissions/Drush/schema of its own. Its one persistent config surface is the Entity Browser display plugin id 'bootstrap4_modal' (adds a modal_size setting), stored on entity_browser.browser.<name> config entities -- medium/hard cases are grounded in namespaced b4m_* entity browsers using that display.

evals.prompt: Using the Bootstrap 4 Modal module, I want a normal link to open its target page in a Bootstrap 4 modal via Drupal's AJAX system. What classes/attributes do I put on the <a> tag?
evals.expected_output: Add class="use-ajax" and data-dialog-type="bootstrap4_modal" (optionally data-dialog-options='{...}') to the link. The module's main content renderer (format drupal_bootstrap4_modal) opens the response in a Bootstrap 4 modal. Its libraries are auto-attached.

evals.prompt: In a Drupal controller/AJAX callback, which command class from the Bootstrap 4 Modal module do I add to an AjaxResponse to open rendered content in a Bootstrap 4 modal, and which one closes it?
evals.expected_output: Add new OpenBootstrap4ModalDialogCommand($title, $content, $dialog_options) to open (or OpenBootstrap4ModalDialogByUrlCommand for a URL), and new CloseBootstrap4ModalDialogCommand() to close (defaults to selector #drupal-bootstrap4-modal). They live in Drupal\bootstrap4_modal\Ajax and extend core's dialog commands.

evals.prompt: With the Bootstrap 4 Modal module, how do I make a modal appear centered and large, and how do I hide its header? Name the dialog options.
evals.expected_output: Pass dialog options (data-dialog-options or the command's $dialog_options): dialogClasses:"modal-dialog-centered modal-lg" for centered+large, and dialogShowHeader:false to hide the header. Other options include buttonClass, buttonPrimaryClass, backdrop, keyboard, focus, autoOpen.

evals.prompt: This site has an Entity Browser with machine name 'b4m_known'. Inspect its live configuration and state which display plugin it uses to present the browser.
evals.expected_output: entity_browser.browser.b4m_known uses display: bootstrap4_modal (the Bootstrap 4 Modal display plugin), so the entity browser opens in a Bootstrap 4 modal.

evals.prompt: The Entity Browser 'b4m_size' opens in a Bootstrap 4 modal. Inspect the live configuration and tell me the modal size that has been configured for it.
evals.expected_output: Its display_configuration.modal_size is 'modal-sm' (a small Bootstrap modal), in entity_browser.browser.b4m_size (display bootstrap4_modal).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site (Entity Browser and Bootstrap 4 Modal are installed), create an Entity Browser with machine name 'b4m_build' that presents itself using the Bootstrap 4 Modal display. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: An entity_browser.browser.b4m_build config entity exists with display: bootstrap4_modal. E.g. EntityBrowser::create(['name'=>'b4m_build','display'=>'bootstrap4_modal', ...])->save().

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create an Entity Browser with machine name 'b4m_large' that uses the Bootstrap 4 Modal display and is configured to open as a LARGE Bootstrap modal (modal-lg). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: An entity_browser.browser.b4m_large config entity exists with display: bootstrap4_modal and display_configuration.modal_size: modal-lg.
